SIG-MEM-005 (obligation-event clock defaults) · SIG-MEM-011 (status

`docs/tickets/247_P34.39a__osm-replay-read-back.md` (manifest row 247,
Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.38-sources-pilot-prep-and-registry-rows` (stacked, H2 PR-1) ·
**Gate:** none — read-only; no operator go needed for a read-back ·
**Live stage:** one read-only leg, clock-guarded (AR-4): it runs only

## Why

D-P31.4-1 is owed an honest read-back of the 2026-10-10T03:35Z OSM
monthly replay (`camreg_osm_surveillance` inside `camreg-batch-05`) —
the first full OSM run on the rolled image `sig-api@sha256:feff986c…`.
Until it is read back, P34.46 cannot start from a known spine. The
replay has not yet happened (the cron is armed for 10-10T03:35Z), so
this row lands the command, the fixtures and the pre-run baseline, and
queues the live leg — no hosted green is fabricated in advance.

## What ships

- **`sig-ops scheduled-readback`** (`ops/src/ops/scheduled_readback.py`
  + the `cli.py` verb) — gathers the Cloud Run execution result, the
  scheduler trigger state, all 17 member `ops/runs` WORM rows on the run
  date, the `ingest_run_completion` row, the `pg_stat_user_tables`
  `n_tup_upd`/`n_tup_del` counters on the ingest write set, the
  `sig-api-health` probe rows, and the Cloud SQL memory/disk/uptime
  series — then judges 13 criteria against D-P31.4-1 + G1 §3.7.
- **Clock guard (AR-4)** — before the fire, without `lastAttemptTime`,
  or without a finished post-fire execution, the command refuses: exit
  `42` (the protect.sh "queued, not failed" convention) with the
  verbatim re-run prompt. Verified **live** on 2026-10-07 — exit 42,
  queued report committed at
  `docs/build/reports/p34.39a-osm-replay-read-back/queued-2026-10-07.json`.
- **Pre-run baseline** (D-P31.4-1's second bullet) — `--write-baseline`
  captured 2026-10-07T16:48Z: `claim` 2,640,429; every claim-table
  counter 0/0; per-source claim counts credited through the evidence
  chain `claim → claim_evidence → evidence_capture →
  evidence_artifact.source_id` (`camreg_osm_surveillance` = 1,241,521 —
  already inside the ≈1.37M ±15 % band from the September load). The
  method is named in the file's `claim_counts_method`: the pre-P31.2
  reuse-by-key runs fold several sources' executions into one
  `ingest_run`, so a run-level map mis-attributes them (the
  2,058,714-claim run `01a0b0ca-…` carries completions for both
  `camreg_monmap_mn` and `camreg_osm_surveillance`; a `DISTINCT ON
  (run_id)` map credited all of it to the alphabetically-first member —
  caught by direct read-only inspection and fixed before the baseline
  was committed).
- **Honest routing** — counter drift / claims far above the band / a
  >3 GB disk jump → `anomaly-stop-and-preserve` (PITR clone to T0, never
  UPDATE/DELETE); over-1h-but-finished → `adr-107-111-revisit` (the
  ADR-107/ADR-111 revisit trigger (a)); ≥36 h →
  `deferral-row:execution-timeout`; other fails → `deferral-row`;
  missing evidence → `not_evaluable` — never a green.
- **P31.7 disclosure** — every verdict report carries the disclosure
  that the pinned `feff986c` image predates P31.7 and records no
  re-sightings, so the replay adds no re-sighting evidence.
- **Fixture replay** — `--fixtures-dir` replays the recorded pass
  fixture (`tests/ops/fixtures/scheduled_readback/pass/`) into the
  identical report shape, offline.
- **D-P31.4-1 stays OPEN** — `obligation-event/1` `D-P31.4-1:e1`
  (OPEN→OPEN) records the progress note; the DEFERRALS row carries the
  appended dated cell. A `DONE` transition requires the post-fire
  verdict.

## Boundaries

Nothing is executed, cancelled or written: the command holds only
read-only calls and refuses before the guard holds (it refused — live,
exit 42). No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` tick, no spine
UPDATE/DELETE, no CI config change, no new verdict word, no DEFERRALS
lead-token change (D-P31.4-1 stays OPEN — OPEN→OPEN progress event
only), `db/sqitch.plan` L44–52 untouched. The queued leg's re-run is
`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/247_P34.39a__osm-replay-read-back.md
live_verification=true`; `live:` out to P34.46 waits on its verdict.

_Size deviation disclosed:_ the change runs ≈ 2,300 lines
(module 1,462 + cli 170 + tests 666) against the S budget's ≤1,500 —
the gathered-evidence surface (13 criteria × 6 sources × fixture replay
× baseline) does not shrink without cutting checks the contract lists.
Recorded in the run ledger's gap table.
